inbox.title: Sales inbox
inbox.description: Purchase enquiries from the contact form, quote requests from people who have not ordered yet, people who saved a design but haven’t ordered, dieline downloads (only from people who agreed to hear from us) and entries the team added — soonest first response first, or by score.
inbox.search: Search name, company, reference or need
inbox.leadRefused: Cannot be registered as a lead
inbox.leadRefusedHint: This contact cannot be registered as a lead; keep in touch as usual.
inbox.emptyManager: New enquiries arrive by themselves from the contact form and quote requests, or add one taken by phone.
inbox.emptyRep: Enquiries your manager assigns to you appear here. If a customer calls you directly, add it as yours.
inbox.failed: That did not go through. Try again.

assignDialog.title: Assign {name}
assignDialog.description: Pick a rep, or let the system pick whoever has the least open work. Assigning registers the lead for that rep.
assignDialog.roundRobinHint: Fewest open enquiries; on a tie, whoever was assigned least recently
assignDialog.reasonHint: Kept in the history; the previous rep sees it
assignDialog.reasonRequired: Say why it moves from the previous rep

contactedDialog.title: Contacted {name}
contactedDialog.description: Records the first response as now.

disqualify.title: Close {name}
disqualify.description: The enquiry closes and no longer counts as open work.

create.title: Add enquiry
create.description: For a customer who called or walked in.
create.assigneeHint: Leave it to the assignment mode in settings
create.reachRequired: Enter a phone or an e-mail

pipeline.title: Leads
pipeline.descriptionManager: Every rep's leads — the same stages and rules as the agent portal.
pipeline.descriptionRep: Your leads. Move a stage from “Move to…” on any row.
pipeline.freelanceReadOnly: Freelance agents' leads are read-only; the agent works them.

empty.ending: No leads close to the end of protection

pipeline.emptyHintManager: Assign inbound enquiries to reps; the leads are registered for them.
pipeline.emptyHintRep: Convert an enquiry you were given and it appears here.

lead.noQuotes: No quotes yet — make one with the button above.
lead.historyHint: Rounds, outcomes and competitors this customer has named.

quote.title: Quote for {name}
quote.description: Start from a spec the desk has quoted, then set the customer's quantity; it is priced like the website.
quote.specHint: Style, material and print stay as in that quote
quote.noSpec: The desk has no quote to start from yet. Ask CS to price the first one.

discount.title: Discount for {code}
discount.description: Say first what the customer gives back, then the discount. The request goes to the approval desk.
discount.giveRequired: Pick at least one thing the customer gives back
discount.pctHint: Before VAT, off the website price

quotes.title: Sales quotes
quotes.description: Quotes sent from the desk's leads, with whether the customer opened them.
quotes.emptyHint: Make a quote from a lead's page.

dashboard.title: Sales team dashboard
dashboard.description: How reps and agents did over the chosen range.

funnel.title: Leads by stage
funnel.hint: How many reached each stage, and the share lost since the previous one

bySource.title: Leads by source
bySource.hint: Most first, with how many were won

medianDays.title: Time in each stage
medianDays.hint: Median days, from the stage moves in the timeline

byRep.title: By rep
byRep.hint: Open a name to see that rep's leads

split.title: Reps against freelance agents
split.hint: The same figures, by kind of seller

approvals.title: Discount approvals
approvals.description: Discount requests from reps and agents, by the time a decision is due. Figures are in each record, in your tier.
approvals.search: Search customer, quote number or agent code
approvals.emptyHint: Discount requests from quotes arrive here by themselves.

give.title: What the customer gives back
give.leadTimeFlexDays: Accepts {days} more days of lead time

tier.full: Full figures for your role, with your name across the chart. Every view is logged.
tier.margin_pct: Your role sees percentages and the floor. Every view is logged.
tier.authority: Your role sees the approval authority only.

locks.title: Factory price lock
locks.hint: A big deal: a lock request is recorded for the approval's validity, awaiting the factory.

decision.notYours: This is your own request; another approver decides it.
decision.selfApproved: Self-approved (solo-owner mode); recorded in the history.

waterfall.bridgeTitle: From the website price to contribution after commission
waterfall.floorLine: Dashed line = margin floor, {pct} of net revenue

authority.why: The level comes from the discount and the floor the system works out.

simulator.title: Try other terms
simulator.hint: Worked out again at once in your tier. Nothing is saved except the view log.
simulator.failed: Could not work it out; adjust the figures

history.title: This customer's negotiation history
history.rule: Negotiation-heavy = {rounds}+ rounds on {quotes} of the last {last} quotes
history.heavyHint: This customer's discount requests go one approval level up.

decision.title: Decide
decision.hint: Approve with options for the customer, counter with what to ask instead, or reject.
decision.standardRate: The seller keeps the usual commission rate

rateHint.co_fund: Below the usual rate: the seller shares the discount

approve.title: Approve and offer the options
approve.body: The seller sees {count} option(s) and may take one while the offer is valid.

counter.title: Counter
counter.body: This request closes; the seller may ask again with different terms.

decision.selfReason: Why you approve your own request
decision.selfReasonHint: At least 10 characters; kept in the history
decision.optionsInvalid: Check every option's figures (up to 2 decimals)

done.approve: Approved — the seller sees the options

views.title: Figures access log
views.description: Who viewed or downloaded which deal's margin figures, in which tier.
views.emptyHint: Every opening of a discount approval is logged here.

playbook.title: Sales playbook
playbook.description: The cards agents and reps see. Edit a draft, submit it, and someone else publishes.

create.title: New card
create.description: Starts as draft v1; write it and preview it on the next page.
create.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. repeat-order

editor.agentWording: Cards agents see may not mention cost, margin or factories; the API refuses them.
editor.publishNeedsSubmit: Submit it first, then it can be published
editor.publishByOther: The author or submitter cannot publish; another person from Marketing or a sales manager does
editor.publishReady: Submitted {at}; ready for you to publish
editor.liveNote: This version is live; make a new draft to change it
editor.notOwner: This card belongs to {owner}; you can read it
editor.previewHint: The same card agents see, updated as you type
editor.publishBody: {audiences} see this version at once; the live version retires
editor.retireBody: Agents and reps will no longer see it

negotiations.description: Rounds, approved discounts, outcomes and competitors, per customer.
negotiations.none: Pick a customer on the left
negotiations.noneHint: Or open it from a lead or a discount approval
negotiations.title: Negotiation history
negotiations.rule: Negotiation-heavy = {rounds}+ rounds on {quotes} of the last {last} quotes

lostToPrice.description: Closed deals lost on price, by product class and quantity band — for the pricing tables.
lostToPrice.title: Share lost to price
lostToPrice.hint: Darker = more lost on price; the count is under each percentage
lostToPrice.empty: No closed deals in this range

postDeal.description: Won deals that had a discount approval: the margin approved against what was made.
postDeal.tierFull: Amounts and percentages, for your role
postDeal.empty: No won deals in this range
postDeal.title: Post-deal review

quoteGross.definition: What the customer pays incl. VAT for the quote's first quantity
quoteGross.formula: Product + shipping + VAT at the website price

leads.definition: Leads registered in the chosen range

won.formula: Counted when the first payment is seen

winRate.definition: Share of closed deals that were won

openValue.definition: Expected value of the leads still open
openValue.formula: Sum of the sellers' expected values (before VAT)

firstResponseSla.definition: Enquiries answered for the first time within the set time
firstResponseSla.formula: Answered in time ÷ all enquiries, in working hours

funnelStep.definition: Leads that reached this stage in the range
funnelStep.formula: From the stage moves in the timeline

dropOff.definition: Share that did not reach this stage from the previous one

wonPerPeriod.definition: Deals won in each period (Bangkok time)

leadsPerPeriod.definition: Leads registered in each period (Bangkok time)

sourceLeads.definition: Leads that came from this source

medianDays.definition: The middle number of days leads spend in this stage
medianDays.formula: Median of the days between stage moves

repLeads.definition: This rep's leads in the range

requestedPct.definition: The discount the seller asked for, off the website price

discountPct.formula: Percent of revenue at the website price, before VAT

grossMarginPct.definition: Gross margin as a share of net revenue
grossMarginPct.formula: (Net revenue − factory cost ± shipping difference − fees − free services) ÷ net revenue

contributionPct.definition: Contribution after commission as a share of net revenue
contributionPct.formula: (Gross margin − commission − credit cost − bad-debt provision) ÷ net revenue

floorPct.definition: The lowest acceptable margin; below it C-Level decides

listRevenue.definition: Revenue for the quoted quantity at the website price

netRevenue.definition: Revenue after the discount, before VAT

factoryCost.definition: What the factory charges for this quantity
factoryCost.formula: From the factory price in force or its quote

shippingDifference.definition: Shipping charged to the customer against what getpack pays

paymentFee.definition: The fee for the customer's payment method
paymentFee.formula: At the rate set per method

freeServices.definition: Samples and services given free in this deal

grossMargin.formula: Net revenue − factory cost ± shipping difference − fees − free services

commission.definition: The seller's commission on this deal

creditCost.definition: The cost of paying the factory before the customer pays (an estimate, not posted)
creditCost.formula: Each factory payment × annual cost of capital × days waited ÷ 365, rounded to the baht

badDebt.definition: Bad-debt provision by the customer's credit grade
badDebt.formula: Net revenue × provision rate for the grade

contributionAfterCommission.definition: What remains after commission and the cost of money; the figure a discount is decided on
contributionAfterCommission.formula: Gross margin − commission − credit cost − bad-debt provision

buyPrice.definition: The factory buy price asked to be locked for the approval's validity

averageApprovedDiscount.definition: Average discount approved for this customer
averageApprovedDiscount.formula: Average of the options the customer took

rounds.definition: How many times a discount was asked on this quote

lostToPricePct.definition: Share of closed deals in this group lost on price
